change.title: Close the R1 typed runtime failure inventory
change.summary: Reconciles the R1-A through R1-E typed failure and recovery envelope as one source-only inventory, reruns the focused matrix and sensitive-information canaries, and requires an exact-SHA source gate plus independent completion review before advancing to R2. Production behavior is unchanged.

basis: R1-A through R1-E production paths and typed projection contracts were reconciled without production changes
focused failure, command, auto-boot, transaction, proxy lifecycle, profile-switch, and boundary regressions passed
complete Rust library regression passed with 482 passed, zero failed, and 41 explicitly ignored isolated or live-bound identities
the compensation credential canary passed and the transaction matrix retained path, credential, and journal secret-free assertions
two parallel isolated compensation tests were rejected as evidence after interference and both passed when rerun serially under their isolation contracts
complete 15-suite GATE-SOURCE and exact-SHA clean-context completion review remain pending
